title: Civilization / Portfolio Health Metric Vector for CGX-UTP

source_gap.search_state: NO EXACT SOURCE FOUND in current Raphael branch, local C:\Cognigrex search, or connected Drive keyword search on 2026-10-07
source_gap.rule: Do not invent expansion/equation. Bind the original RUVR definition when recovered and crosswalk it to the metric vector.

principle: Use a vector/dashboard by default, not one opaque civilization score; any composite requires declared weights, normalization, uncertainty and owner approval.

metrics.name: capability closure
metrics.measure: fraction of required functional graph currently qualified locally

metrics.name: critical seed dependency
metrics.measure: mass/count/criticality of imported or single-source items required to reproduce capability

metrics.name: local material fraction
metrics.measure: qualified local material mass / total material mass

metrics.name: circularity
metrics.measure: reused/recycled/recovered material fraction with retained quality evidence

metrics.name: energy closure
metrics.measure: local generation/storage adequacy and energy per accepted functional output

metrics.name: repairability
metrics.measure: fraction of likely failure modes accessible to inspect/repair/remanufacture locally

metrics.name: resilience
metrics.measure: capability retained under node/provider/network/material failures and time-to-recover

metrics.name: ecological outcome
metrics.measure: resource extraction, waste, toxicity/emissions, habitat/biodiversity effects and verified cleanup/restoration outcomes

metrics.name: public benefit/access
metrics.measure: availability, affordability, accessibility, community/worker benefit and essential-service improvement

metrics.name: interoperability/exit
metrics.measure: share of interfaces/passports/formats with safe provider substitution or fork path

metrics.name: evidence readiness
metrics.measure: weighted maturity of source, analytic, bench, integrated and operational evidence across the dependency graph

metrics.name: safety/governance closure
metrics.measure: fraction of required hazard, authority, ecological, legal and human-override gates closed

metrics.name: economic sustainability
metrics.measure: cost, maintenance, throughput, revenue/savings/public-value and capital replacement burden

metrics.name: expansion leverage
metrics.measure: future qualified production/capability enabled per unit mass, energy, time and scarce seed consumed

type_path.T1: high terrestrial/regional energy-material-data coordination with ecological/public-benefit closure
type_path.INTERPLANETARY: federated local-horizon nodes exchanging resources, evidence and functions without single-point dependence
type_path.T2_FRONTIER: long-horizon energy/material/ecological closure planning only; no readiness inference from taxonomy

anti_gaming: no single metric can erase a safety/ecology hard gate
throughput/revenue cannot compensate for invalid evidence
local-only cannot silently substitute unqualified material
